name: 11793 · Wantagh, NY
findings: ZIP 11793 (Wantagh) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11793 (Wantagh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
